title: Three Winters and One Short Ledger
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：integrity　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 integrity 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the judge ① kept the integrity that no neighbour in the chamber would have recorded, and he said the keeping was the whole of the winter. The ② integrity, meaning the honesty itself and not the ledger, ran three winters and stayed unrecorded in the book; integrity, he said, is the only thing in a chamber that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of integrity in that chamber had the same short ledger beside it, and the ④ integrity at the far door, meaning the oath they kept for the children to repeat and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Integrity, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the judge said the recording is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the integrity was the whole of the matter, meaning the character and not the honesty. The ⑥ integrity, meaning the character and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; integrity, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both honesty and a character. He said the character is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ integrity had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short ledger. The ⑧ integrity of the whole thing, the judge wrote in November, was one chamber and three winters of recording; integrity, he said, is either the oath at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ integrity I remember is the integrity recorded in the register, which closed in 1984 and is still recorded as the quietest in the chamber. ⑩ Integrity, my mother said in 1986, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all integrity, she said, is a character that has agreed to look like honesty. She said the character was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 正直；诚信（指议事厅里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 正直；诚信（指那份正直本身，与账簿相对）

F. n. 正直；诚信（指登记册里写到、被记下的的那一份）
G. n. 品格、操守（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: keep the integrity 意为“坚守这份正直”，1977 年那位法官把议事厅里没有一位邻居肯记录的一份正直做了一遍。
integrity 意为“正直；诚信”，指那份正直本身而不是账簿，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被记录。
integrity 意为“正直；诚信”，指议事厅里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一本薄薄的账簿。
integrity 意为“正直；诚信”，指最远那扇门口留给孩子们跟着念的一句那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
integrity 意为“品格、操守”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份品格就是那件事的全部。
integrity 意为“操守”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份正直，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
integrity 意为“正直；诚信”，指登记册里写到、被记下的的那一份，到 1982 年这一份成了登记册里的一行。
integrity 意为“品性之事”，法官十一月写道，整件事的正直之事是一处议事厅和三个冬天的记录。
integrity 意为“正直；诚信”，我记得的是登记册里记录过的那一份，1984 年守住了，至今仍被说成议事厅里最安静的一份。
integrity 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，正直是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的正直。
